findings.description: _store compares len(self._keys_by_country), the number of distinct countries, against max_entries. The cache holds up to one entry per (country, postal_code) pair, so with a handful of countries the cache never evicts, however many postal codes are looked up. Memory grows with every distinct postal code requested, and the cache_size limit and the evictions metric do not behave as documented. Eviction should depend on the number of cached entries.
findings.suggestion: Change the loop condition to `while len(self._entries) > self._max_entries:`.
findings.title: Cache size bound counts countries instead of entries, so the cache grows without limit
